models.ff_models — Force Fields¶

The models.ff_models module implements the coarse-grained force fields used to compute pairwise residue interaction potentials. Each force field class provides methods for computing unbonded energies (short-range + electrostatic), charges, and pair-charge arrays.

Module-Level Constants¶

models.ff_models.RES_ALPHA¶

The 23-character residue alphabet: "MGKTRADEYVLQWFSHNPCIXZB".

models.ff_models.NUM_RESIDUES¶

Number of residue types (23).

models.ff_models.DEBYE_RC¶

Default Debye-Hückel electrostatic cutoff distance (90.0 Å).

models.ff_models.RES_CODE¶

Dictionary mapping single-letter residue codes to three-letter names.

File I/O Functions¶

models.ff_models.read_MPIPI_ff_params(fpath)[source]¶

Read MPIPI force field parameters from a whitespace-delimited file.

Parameters:

fpath – Path to the MPIPI parameter file.

Returns:

Tuple of (eps_table, eps_flattened, sigma_flattened, nu_flattened, mu_flattened, rc_flattened) — the 23x23 epsilon table and flattened (529,) arrays for each parameter.

models.ff_models.read_HPS(fpath)[source]¶

Read HPS force field parameters from a whitespace-delimited file.

Parameters:

fpath – Path to the HPS parameter file.

Returns:

Tuple of (lambda_table, eps_flattened, sigma_flattened, lambda_flattened) — the 23x23 lambda table and flattened (529,) arrays.

models.ff_models.read_calvados(fpath)[source]¶

Read CALVADOS force field parameters from a text file.

Parameters:

fpath – Path to the CALVADOS parameter file.

Returns:

Tuple of (lambdas, lambdas_flattened, sigmas_flattened) — per-residue lambdas and pairwise-averaged flattened (529,) arrays.

models.ff_models.read_KH_D(fpath)[source]¶

Read Kim-Hummer-D force field parameters from a text file.

Parameters:

fpath – Path to the KH-D parameter file.

Returns:

Tuple of (eps_table, eps_flattened, sigma_flattened, lambda_flattened) — the 23x23 epsilon table and flattened (529,) arrays. Lambda is +1 for repulsive pairs and -1 for attractive.

Utility Functions¶

models.ff_models.seq_to_one_hot(seq)[source]¶

Convert an amino acid sequence string to a one-hot encoded array.

Parameters:

seq – Amino acid sequence string using RES_ALPHA characters.

Returns:

One-hot array of shape (len(seq), 23).

MPIPI Model¶

class models.ff_models.MPIPI_model(version='GG')[source]¶

Bases: object

Mpipi coarse-grained force field for IDP interactions.

Combines Wang-Frenkel short-range potentials with Debye-Huckel electrostatics. Supports normal, GG, and FINCHES variants.

Initialization

__init__(version='GG')[source]¶

Initialize the MPIPI model.

Parameters:

version – ‘GG’, ‘normal’, or ‘GG_FINCHES’.

Charge Computation

calculate_charges(pH=7, pH_mode='normal')[source]¶

Compute per-residue-type charges.

In ‘normal’ mode, uses fixed partial charges. In ‘pH’ mode, computes Henderson-Hasselbalch titration charges.

Parameters:

  • pH – Solution pH (used only in ‘pH’ mode).

  • pH_mode – ‘normal’ or ‘pH’.

Returns:

Charge array of shape (23,), ordered by RES_ALPHA.

create_pair_charges(charges)[source]¶

Build all 529 charge pairs from per-residue charges.

Parameters:

charges – Per-residue-type charges, shape (23,).

Returns:

Array of shape (529, 2) with [qi, qj] for each pair.

Potential Functions

wang_frenkel_internal_func(r, r_c, sigma, nu, mu, eps)¶

Evaluate the Wang-Frenkel potential at distance r.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance (scalar or array).

  • r_c – Cutoff distance.

  • sigma – Length scale parameter.

  • nu – Exponent parameter.

  • mu – Exponent parameter.

  • eps – Well depth (energy scale).

Returns:

Potential energy at r, zero beyond r_c.

wang_frenkel_internal_func_FINCHES(r, r_c, sigma, nu, mu, eps)¶

Wang-Frenkel potential variant used by the FINCHES model.

Uses Rij = 3*sigma as the cutoff regardless of r_c.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • r_c – Cutoff distance (unused; Rij = 3*sigma is used instead).

  • sigma – Length scale parameter.

  • nu – Exponent parameter.

  • mu – Exponent parameter.

  • eps – Well depth.

Returns:

Potential energy at r.

coulomb_internal_func(r, qij, r_c, temp, salt_conc)¶

Evaluate screened Coulomb (Debye-Huckel) potential.

Uses a fixed dielectric constant of 80 and salt-dependent screening.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • qij – Charge pair [qi, qj].

  • r_c – Electrostatic cutoff distance.

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin (unused in this variant).

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

Returns:

Electrostatic energy at r, zero beyond r_c.

coulomb_internal_func_FINCHES(r, qij, r_c, temp, salt_conc)¶

Screened Coulomb potential variant used by the FINCHES model.

Computes Debye-Huckel electrostatics with salt-dependent screening using SI-based constants and returns energy in kJ/mol.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance in Angstroms.

  • qij – Charge pair [qi, qj].

  • r_c – Cutoff distance (unused).

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

Returns:

Electrostatic energy at r in kJ/mol.

Variant Swapping

swap_wf_func()[source]¶

Replace the Wang-Frenkel potential with the FINCHES variant.

swap_coul_func()[source]¶

Replace the Coulomb potential with the FINCHES variant.

Combined Potential

calculate_unbonded(r, pair_charges, salt_conc, temp)¶

Compute total unbonded energy (WF + Coulomb) for all 529 pairs.

Parameters:

  • r – Radial distance(s).

  • pair_charges – Charge pairs, shape (529, 2).

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

Returns:

Total unbonded energies, shape (529,) or (529, len(r)).

HPS Model¶

class models.ff_models.HPS_model(version='Dignon')[source]¶

Bases: object

HPS (hydrophobicity scale) coarse-grained force field.

Combines Ashbaugh-Hatch short-range potentials with Debye-Huckel electrostatics. Supports Dignon, Tesei, Urry, and FB parameterizations.

Potential Functions

ashbaugh_hatch_internal_func(r, eps, sigma, lambda_)¶

Evaluate the Ashbaugh-Hatch potential at distance r.

Combines a repulsive WCA core with a lambda-scaled attractive tail.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • eps – Well depth.

  • sigma – Length scale.

  • lambda – Hydrophobicity parameter (0 = repulsive, 1 = attractive).

Returns:

Potential energy at r.

coulomb_internal_func(r, qij, r_c, salt_conc)¶

Evaluate screened Coulomb potential for HPS model.

Uses precomputed epsilon_r and debye_kappa from get_relative_perm and get_debye_kappa.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • qij – Charge pair [qi, qj].

  • r_c – Electrostatic cutoff distance.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM (unused; kappa precomputed).

Returns:

Electrostatic energy at r, zero beyond r_c.

Combined Potential

calculate_unbonded(r, pair_charges, salt_conc, temp)¶

Compute total unbonded energy (Ashbaugh-Hatch + Coulomb) for all 529 pairs.

Also updates internal epsilon_r and debye_kappa for the given conditions.

Parameters:

  • r – Radial distance(s).

  • pair_charges – Charge pairs, shape (529, 2).

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

Returns:

Total unbonded energies, shape (529,) or (529, len(r)).

CALVADOS Model¶

class models.ff_models.Calvados_model(version='2')[source]¶

Bases: object

CALVADOS coarse-grained force field for IDP interactions.

Combines HPS-style Lennard-Jones short-range potentials with Yukawa electrostatics. Supports versions 1 and 2.

Initialization

__init__(version='2')[source]¶

Initialize the CALVADOS model.

Parameters:

version – ‘1’ or ‘2’.

Charge Computation

calculate_charges(pH=7, pH_mode='normal')[source]¶

Compute per-residue-type charges for the CALVADOS model.

Parameters:

  • pH – Solution pH (used only in ‘pH’ mode).

  • pH_mode – ‘normal’ or ‘pH’.

Returns:

Charge array of shape (23,), ordered by RES_ALPHA.

create_pair_charges(charges)[source]¶

Build all 529 charge pairs from per-residue charges.

Parameters:

charges – Per-residue-type charges, shape (23,).

Returns:

Array of shape (529, 2).

Potential Functions

hps_lj_internal_func(r, sigma, lam)¶

Evaluate the CALVADOS HPS Lennard-Jones potential.

Shifted Ashbaugh-Hatch form with eps = 0.2 kJ/mol and cutoff at 20 Angstroms.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • sigma – Length scale.

  • lam – Hydrophobicity parameter.

Returns:

Potential energy at r.

calvados_coul_internal_func(r, qij, r_c, temp, salt_conc)¶

Standard Yukawa electrostatics for CALVADOS.

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance.

  • qij – Charge pair [qi, qj].

  • r_c – Electrostatic cutoff distance.

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

Returns:

Electrostatic energy at r, zero beyond r_c.

calvados_coul_internal_func_FINCHES(r, qij, r_c, temp, salt_conc)¶

FINCHES-variant Yukawa electrostatics for CALVADOS.

Uses temperature-dependent Bjerrum length and returns energy in kcal/mol (divided by 4.184 from kJ).

Parameters:

  • r – Interparticle distance in Angstroms.

  • qij – Charge pair [qi, qj].

  • r_c – Cutoff distance (unused; internal cutoff = 4 nm).

  • temp – Temperature in Kelvin.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.

Returns:

Yukawa electrostatic energy at r in kcal/mol.

Variant Swapping

swap_coul_func()[source]¶

Replace the Coulomb potential with the FINCHES-compatible variant.

  • salt_conc – Salt concentration in mM.
